effects.description: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may add 1 card from your Life area to your hand: This Character gains +2000 power during this turn. Then, give this Character up to 2 rested DON!! cards.
conditions: You have at least 1 card in your Life area
You have up to 2 rested DON!! cards to give
steps: (Optional) Add 1 card from your Life area to your hand
If you did, this Character gains +2000 power during this turn
Then, attach up to 2 rested DON!! cards from your DON!! area to this Character
notes: You can only use this effect once per turn
You can choose not to use this effect
If you don't take a card from your Life area, the other effects will not happen
